name: Leg Slides
summary: Lying on the back with knees bent, one heel slides away along the mat until the leg is long, then slides home, with the pelvis still.
steps: Lie on the back, knees bent, feet flat, spine neutral.
Breathe out to slide one heel away until the leg is straight.
Breathe in to slide it back.

layers.title: Add the arm
layers.text: The opposite arm reaches overhead as the leg slides.

layers.title: Hover the heel
layers.text: Slide out a centimetre above the mat.

cautions.note: Not lying flat after the first 12 weeks.

cues:
The pelvis is a bowl of water: nothing spills.
The waist stays the same length both sides.

review.note: Draft entry written for OpenPilates. Needs review by a qualified Pilates instructor before teaching from it.
